item.title: No, This Bunny Walking With A Candle Is Not From 'Animal Croissing,' Her Name Is Umi From 'Rental'
item.description: Umi Walking With a Candle refers to a GIF of the bunny character Umi from the Steam indie horror game "Rental" nervously walking down a dark hallway with a candle.

item.title: This BanBan GIF Has Been Used To Mourn Lost Media, Both Real And Not, Since 2023
item.description: X Is… Lost Media or BanBan Crying is a reaction meme format using the phrasal template, "X is… lost media?," "X" being a given subject, alongside a reaction GIF of BanBan from Garten of BanBan putting his tongue in his mouth and crying. The GIF originates from an April 2023 video by YouTuber Horror Skunx and the meme was popularized as early as August of that year. The meme is often used to ironically to falsely claim that something is now lost media.

item.title: Based 'Fire Duck' Is Still One Of The More Wicked Animal Photos On The Web
item.description: Goose on Fire, also known as Fire Duck, is a perfectly timed photograph of a goose running in front of a campfire, appearing as if its head is aflame due to the perspective the picture was taken from.

item.title: The 'Blinking White Guy' Meme Is 12 Years Old Today
item.description: Drew Scanlon Reaction, also known as Blinking White Guy, is a GIF of Drew Scanlon, video editor and podcaster at video game website Giant Bomb. The GIF of Scanlon is used as a reaction image capturing feeling slightly insulted or confused.

item.title: 'Dogecoin,' The Original Meme Coin Cryptocurrency, Was Minted On This Fateful Day
item.description: Dogecoin is an alternative cryptocurrency (altcoin) that uses the iconic Shibu Inu dog from the Doge meme as a mascot.
